features.nameAr: إضافة من 1 إلى 3 إيميلات تنبيه لكل موقع
features.nameEn: One to three notification recipients per site
features.notes: Implemented owner-scoped recipients, validation, deduplication, enable/disable, SQLite compatibility and tests. Awaiting clean build/runtime verification and explicit upgrade path for existing non-SQLite databases.
Implemented tenant-safe per-site SMTP profile, account-profile inheritance mode, encrypted password storage and UI. Awaiting clean build/runtime verification and existing non-SQLite schema upgrades.
Implemented account SMTP profile, up to three dashboard recipients, encrypted credentials, SQLite compatibility, account UI and site inheritance. Awaiting clean build/runtime verification.

SMTP passwords use the existing secret-protection abstraction, remain write-only in UI, can be rotated or cleared, and are decrypted only for delivery/diagnostics. Awaiting clean build/runtime verification.

features.nameAr: اختبار إعدادات البريد وإرسال رسالة تجريبية
features.notes: Implemented shared DNS/TCP diagnostics, sanitized TLS/auth/SMTP test-send reporting, account diagnostics UI, site diagnostics workspace, and test-profile separation from outbound-enabled state. Awaiting clean build/runtime verification against real SMTP providers.

Implemented application-level renderer abstraction, six stable bilingual template keys, RTL/LTR HTML and plain-text bodies, HTML encoding, subject newline sanitization, required-token validation, catalog metadata and regression tests. Awaiting clean build/test verification before completion.

Implementation started: added the persistent EmailSchedule domain model with explicit owner/site scope, hourly/daily/weekly/monthly frequency rules, timezone identifier, retry policy, next/last run state and EF Core indexes/relationships. Next: existing-database schema upgrade, tenant-safe schedule service, next-run calculator, scheduler worker integration, UI and tests.
Account-level digest independent of individual site schedules.

features.nameEn: Email outbox, retries, idempotency, and correlation
features.notes: Implemented durable outbox entities, owner-scoped idempotency, recipient/message snapshots, persisted delivery scope, atomic conditional claims, exponential retry/backoff, stale-claim restart recovery, sanitized attempt history, SQLite compatibility, DI registration, active background SMTP worker and regression tests. Awaiting clean build/tests and real-provider runtime verification before completion.

Implemented tenant-safe account/site delivery history service and bilingual /email/history workspace with site/status/correlation filters, message metadata, retry attempt history, idempotency/correlation identifiers, sanitized failure diagnostics, Site Settings navigation, global Operations navigation/quick-search entry and regression tests for tenant isolation and filtering. Awaiting clean build/runtime verification before completion.
Sync/job/security/billing events routed through the outbox.

features.nameEn: Email rate limits, duplicate suppression, and retention
features.notes: Configurable per-account limits and cleanup policy.
Localized plan name, interval, price, currency, trial/grace settings, gateway mapping.
Plan-name checks are forbidden; use entitlement keys and server-side enforcement.
Trialing/Active/PastDue/Grace/Suspended/Cancelled/Expired with audited transitions.

features.nameEn: Trial, grace-period, suspension, and expiry policies
features.notes: Never delete user/site data because payment state is temporarily unavailable.
Current plan, renewal, status, limits, usage, upgrade/downgrade/cancel and history.
Business logic must not depend directly on PayPal.
Sandbox/live configuration, encrypted client credentials, validation diagnostics.
Checkout is server-created; browser return is navigation only and never proof of payment.
Verify authenticity, store unique gateway event IDs, process replay safely.

features.notes: Activation, renewal, failure, suspension, cancellation and reconciliation.

features.notes: Policy-driven effective dates and audited transitions.
